newsitem.title: UK: Dixons current same store sales up 8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Dixons current same store sales up 8 pct.

text.p: British electronics retailer Dixons Group Plc said like-for-like sales in the first eight weeks of the second half were up eight percent, with total sales in the period up 20 percent over a year ago.
Gross margins in the period were "at similar levels year-on- year," chairman Sir Stanley Kalms said in a statement.
The group said in a statement that first half sales from existing stores were also up eight percent, with total sales in the period climbing 24 percent to 1,045 million stg.
